Protection · Control · Distribution

Find the right NOARK product family.

Start with your part number, drawings or application. Use the manufacturer links for current specifications; contact us to review the project requirements.

Molded-case circuit breakers

Looking for a NOARK MCCB? Explore the Ex9M and Ex9MHV families. Share voltage, amperage, pole count, interrupting rating and trip requirements so we can help narrow the configuration.

NOARK MCCB specifications

Air circuit breakers

Explore NOARK A25, A32 and A40 power circuit breakers for distribution projects. Mounting, trip functions, accessories and assembly requirements all matter when specifying a breaker. Send your one-line diagram or equipment schedule for review.

NOARK air circuit breaker families

Miniature circuit breakers

Review NOARK MCB options for your panel or equipment design. Identify the required listing, AC or DC application, voltage, poles and trip curve before selecting a part.

NOARK miniature circuit breakers

Contactors & motor starters

NOARK’s industrial-control range includes contactors, overload relays and manual motor starters. Bring us the motor nameplate, coil voltage and control requirements to help identify the appropriate components.

NOARK industrial controls

VFDs & soft starters

Discuss NOARK variable frequency drives and soft starters for motor applications. Tell us about the load, motor rating, supply voltage and operating sequence so we can coordinate selection questions with the manufacturer.

Explore motor-control options

Switchboards & panelboard kits

NOARK’s low-voltage assemblies include MxS switchboards and MxP panelboard kits. Share the project specification and required configuration to discuss product scope, availability and next steps with our team.

NOARK low-voltage assemblies
Regional sales & application support

NOARK support across four states.

For projects in Utah, Idaho, Colorado or Wyoming, work with CT Electrical Sales to review product needs and coordinate the next step with NOARK.

Send a useful quote request

Include your project location, part number or bill of materials, quantity, electrical ratings and requested delivery date. Attach drawings and the specification when available.

Review alternatives carefully

Send the full catalog number and nameplate photo of an existing breaker or control component. Physical fit, ratings, listings and equipment compatibility must be reviewed; a similar rating does not establish interchangeability.

Who is the NOARK representative for Utah, Idaho, Colorado and Wyoming?

CT Electrical Sales represents NOARK Electric in these four states, as confirmed in NOARK’s October 2026 partnership announcement.

Can I request pricing for NOARK breakers and controls?

Yes. Send the product number or application requirements to our sales team. Pricing, ordering arrangements, availability and lead times are confirmed for each request; this page does not imply products are held in local stock.

Where can I get NOARK cutsheets, manuals and drawings?

Use NOARK’s Download Center and the product pages above for manufacturer documentation. We can help identify the documents relevant to your selected part.
